title: Personal Checking: certificate principal in the Private Client Checking conversion test
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the Relationship Balance of a Personal Checking owner is tested for a requested conversion to Private Client Checking. It states what the owner's PCB certificates of deposit contribute.

## Formal clause

For this test, the certificate contribution is the principal balance of the owner's certificate in each of the statuses applied, active and grace period. The owner's certificate principal in these counted statuses is a part of the Relationship Balance.

## Counted statuses

| Owner's certificate status | Principal counted in the conversion test |
|---|---|
| Applied | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Grace period | Yes |
| Any other status | No |

## Worked cases (hypothetical owners)

- An owner holds an active certificate with principal of 90000.00 USD. That 90000.00 USD enters the conversion test.
- An owner's certificate is in grace period status with principal of 40000.00 USD. Grace period is counted, so 40000.00 USD enters the test.
- An owner's certificate is closed. It contributes nothing.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "certificate interest accrued to date is added to the principal". **Correct basis:** the figure counted is the principal balance.
